AMD never misses an opportunity to miss an opportunity: The company took to social media during the Jensen Huang NVIDIA chaos to signal its virtues as the company that has never forgotten gamers and has always been by the side of the consumer, just a week or so after telling the world that it is now a “data center-first company.” Lisa Su, cousin to Jensen Huang and AMD CEO, has invested heavily in the US government via her company’s contributions to SuperPACs like MAGA, Inc., lobbyists, and friendship with the President’s wife. Now, when Jensen was being piled on, AMD made sure to tout its virtues and gaslight consumers by spreading mixed messages.
